content.short: PlayMuse Market is a decentralized marketplace on TON for digital content, focusing on music and creator NFTs.
content.description: PlayMuse Market is an innovative decentralized marketplace built on the TON blockchain, specifically designed for the next generation of digital creators. It focuses on empowering artists, particularly in the music industry, by providing a platform to mint, sell, and auction NFTs that represent their work and exclusive fan experiences. PlayMuse facilitates direct creator-to-fan interactions, ensuring that artists retain a larger share of their earnings while providing fans with unique digital collectibles and access within the TON ecosystem.
content.meta: Discover and support creators on PlayMuse Market, the TON-based NFT marketplace. Explore music NFTs on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
